scope: Mesh bounds and existing actor transforms inspected in the editor. These are authoring conventions, not proof of native slot or edit interoperability.

policy_space.wall_yaw: Policy normal direction; mesh yaw is policy yaw + 90 degrees
policy_space.ramp_yaw: Policy uphill direction; mesh yaw is policy yaw - 90 degrees

mesh_space.wall: Centered X, normal Y, base Z=0; width 512, height 384
mesh_space.floor: X=-256..256, Y=0..512; pivot on rear edge
mesh_space.ramp: X=-256..256, Y=0..512; rises toward +Y to Z=384

obj_import.observed_reason: The inspected OBJ importer mirrors Y; asymmetric floor bounds verify compensation. Do not assume this contract for another format or import pipeline.
